backend/main.mo: Motoko canister storing user-specific liquidity lines and boxes with methods to create, update, and query indicator state and monthly candles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to related files, components, and test requirements for market data and chart UI updates.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten short summaries of all frontend files for reference during build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining CSS variables for light/dark themes and chart color tokens using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component applying theme provider and rendering the LiquidityMapperPage with notifications.
Recharts-based candlestick chart rendering BTC monthly data along with liquidity lines and boxes using a custom tooltip and shapes.
frontend/src/components/ChartStates.tsx: UI components showing loading, error, and empty states with generic market-data wording and retry support.
frontend/src/features/data/fetchUtils.ts: Reusable fetch helpers providing timeout, abort handling, response validation, and custom MarketDataError classification.
frontend/src/features/data/types.ts: Defines Candle interface and normalization helpers for converting Binance and CoinGecko responses into a unified candle format.
frontend/src/features/data/useMonthlyCan: Fetches BTC monthly candles from Binance with a CoinGecko fallback and exposes them through a React Query hook.
frontend/src/features/liquidity/liquidit: Implements logic to detect liquidity lines and boxes from candle data by analyzing trend reversals and wick ranges.
frontend/src/features/liquidity/types.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for liquidity lines, liquidity boxes, and the overall liquidity model.
frontend/src/features/liquidity/useLiqui: Wraps liquidity model computation in a memoized React hook based on provided candles.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing related queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and logic using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a backend candle query that retrieves monthly candles via the authenticated actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining dark financial theme variables and global styles.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React root, sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, and renders the app.
frontend/src/pages/LiquidityMapperPage.t: Displays monthly BTC candles with loading/error states and renders the liquidity chart UI.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom theme colors, typography, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, architecture notes, known issues, and existing feature definitions for a BTC monthly OHLCV chart app with automated liquidity detection. Indicates a current data-fetch failure and marks the file as a fix request.
